what: Cards stand around two circles centered outside the left and right edges of the panel, bracketing the center text like parentheses — circle radius is .43 of panel height (phone .36), and only .17 of the width (phone .2) enters the panel. Cards lie along the radius and turn around the circle, the two circles spin on their own in opposite directions at .035rad per second and turn an extra .0006rad per 1px of scroll

options.speed: Auto-rotate speed (rad/s), default .035 — 0 means scroll only
options.scroll: Extra rotation per 1px of scroll (rad), default .0006
options.reach: Width ratio entering the panel, default .17
options.width: Card width ÷ board width, default .086 (74px on phones)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card (child) — front half is the left circle, back half is the right circle

note: The original has dozens of cards (16 per side). Rests when the board is off-screen, with reduced motion it stops where it is
